_description: Local fresh-chain (d2240fea) testnet fleet for coincync-tick. Only RPC-reachable nodes belong here — probe_peer dials http://{ip}:{rpc_port} per entry. The remote seed 2.29.34.197 is intentionally NOT listed: its RPC is loopback/firewalled (unreachable from this box), so listing it would only manufacture a false partition signal. Add a node here only once its RPC is reachable from wherever the tick runs.
_last_changed: 2026-09-07 — created for the local Act-host demo; single reachable node (local miner) at 127.0.0.1.

local-miner.notes: The local synced miner node on this box (fresh d2240fea chain). The one RPC endpoint reachable from here; gives the forager a real peer to score and tip/health real numbers.
